title: D8 agent output (d8-fact-line-writer)
description: Section 12/D8 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d8-fact-line-writer.md's worked output shape: {"fact_line", "facts": [...], "confidence"}. The style rules (present tense, subject first, no option numbers, no 'which of the following'; 'Problem: ... Rule: ...' for numericals; ' | '-joined true-statement facts for statement questions) are checked as far as a script honestly can in scripts/checks/D8.py — that file's docstring says exactly which of them are NOT mechanically checkable and why. `note` is optional, carrying Universal rule 7 (added deliberately: its absence from schemas/D1.json/D2.json was a real bug, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 2026-10-12).

fact_line.description: One line stating the fact this question tests, in the standard wording. For a numerical: 'Problem: <setup in general terms>. Rule: <formula>.' with no specific numbers.

facts.description: For a statement question, the fact of each TRUE statement, in the same order as fact_line joins them with ' | '. Empty for a single-fact question or a numerical (the agent file's own numerical example has facts: []).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
